cases.method: Free-space Biot-Savart convolution of exported cold J; zero-padded linear FFT, self-cell integral zero by symmetry. Source cubes within four cells use subcell quadrature when enabled; farther sources use cell centres.
limits: Diagnostic only: no feedback on current, moving interface or force in the recorded fluid run.
